## How to read this page

```
sing-box JSON       node body              sanitizer            core config
or a form field ──▶ sing-box JSON,    ──▶  checks each     ──▶  what sing-box
                    stored in state         body field's         is actually
                                            value                started with
```

- **Body fields** — the node body itself: the sing-box JSON kept in the launcher state, with the rule applied to each value.
- **Diagnosed problems** — every warning code a node of this scheme can carry, and the field that raises it.
- **Replacements** — what is silently rewritten on the way in: other spellings of the same name, values normalized or substituted, and structural decisions the mapper takes before any value is judged.
- **Degradation** — the same rules grouped by outcome: what drops the node, what only drops a field, and what is merely worth knowing.

A bad value never breaks the whole config: the field is dropped, replaced or — at worst — the single node is.

## Link parameters

The scheme has no link form: it comes from sing-box JSON only.

## Body fields

The node body itself — the sing-box JSON kept in the launcher state. The path is the one used in that body.

- <a id="body-server"></a>**`server`** — Gateway address: host, host:port or URL.
  - Type: string
  - Required: the node is dropped without it
  - Form: block `connection`, required
- <a id="body-flavor"></a>**`flavor`** — Gateway protocol flavor.
  - Type: enum, role `variant`, `fortinet`, `anyconnect`, `gp`, `f5`, `pulse`, `nc`
  - Default: `anyconnect`
  - If invalid: node dropped → [`openconnect_flavor_invalid`](../warnings.md#openconnect_flavor_invalid)
  - Form: block `connection`, required
- <a id="body-username"></a>**`username`** — Account name on the gateway.
  - Type: string
  - Form: block `connection`, required unless any of `tls.client_certificate_path`, `tls.client_certificate`, `cookie` is set
- <a id="body-password"></a>**`password`** — Account password.
  - Type: string, secret
  - Form: block `connection`
- <a id="body-auth-group"></a>**`auth_group`** — Authentication group (realm) on the gateway.
  - Type: string
  - Form: block `security`, shown when `flavor` is none of `fortinet`
- <a id="body-token"></a>**`token`** — Built-in one-time code generator.
  - Type: object
- <a id="body-token-mode"></a>**`token.mode`** — One-time code generator.
  - Type: enum, `totp`, `hotp`, `stoken`, `oidc`
  - Required: the node is dropped without it
  - Form: block `security`
- <a id="body-token-secret"></a>**`token.secret`** — Token secret.
  - Type: string, secret
  - Required: the node is dropped without it
  - Form: block `security`, required, shown when any of `token.mode` is set
- <a id="body-token-secret-path"></a>**`token.secret_path`** — Path to a file with the token secret.

  - Conflicts with: `token.secret`
- <a id="body-token-counter"></a>**`token.counter`** — HOTP counter.
  - Type: int, `0–…`
  - Form: block `security`, shown when `token.mode` is `hotp`
- <a id="body-token-other-keys"></a>**`token.*`** — Other token keys pass through as written.
  - Other keys of this object pass through as written: no rules, no `unknown_key`; emitted here in alphabetical order. Not inherited by nested objects
- <a id="body-user-agent"></a>**`user_agent`** — User-Agent the client presents to the gateway.
  - Type: string, must match `^[^\r\n\x00]*$`

### Form layout

Read by the node forms only; the sanitizer ignores it. A hidden field stays in the body as written.

- Blocks: `connection`, `security`, `advanced`
- Choice `server_cert_check` in block `security`: `system` (nothing set) · `pinned` (`tls.peer_fingerprint`) · `insecure` (`tls.insecure`). Active is the option with the most set paths (its paths and `set` keys) among those with a set path, the first on a tie; switching clears the other options' paths

## Diagnosed problems

Every code that can be raised on a node of this scheme, including the ones coming from the shared TLS, transport, multiplex and dialer sub-schemas. Follow a code for what it means and what to do about it.

- [`field_conflict`](../warnings.md#field_conflict)
  - [`token.secret_path`](#body-token-secret-path) — conflicts with `token.secret` → removed
  - [`tls.certificate_authority_path`](#body-tls-certificate-authority-path) — conflicts with `tls.certificate_authority` → removed
  - [`tls.client_certificate_path`](#body-tls-client-certificate-path) — conflicts with `tls.client_certificate` → removed
  - [`tls.client_key_path`](#body-tls-client-key-path) — conflicts with `tls.client_key` → removed
- [`field_missing`](../warnings.md#field_missing)
  - [`server`](#body-server) — required and missing → node dropped
  - [`token.mode`](#body-token-mode) — required and missing → node dropped
  - [`token.secret`](#body-token-secret) — required and missing → node dropped
- [`field_requires`](../warnings.md#field_requires)
  - [`tls.client_certificate_path`](#body-tls-client-certificate-path) — set without `tls.client_key_path` (unless `tls.client_key` is set) → removed
  - [`tls.client_key_path`](#body-tls-client-key-path) — set without `tls.client_certificate_path` (unless `tls.client_certificate` is set) → removed
- [`openconnect_fingerprint_invalid`](../warnings.md#openconnect_fingerprint_invalid)
  - [`tls.peer_fingerprint`](#body-tls-peer-fingerprint) — the value does not fit the field → removed
- [`openconnect_flavor_invalid`](../warnings.md#openconnect_flavor_invalid)
  - [`flavor`](#body-flavor) — the value does not fit the field → node dropped
- [`openconnect_insecure_crypto`](../warnings.md#openconnect_insecure_crypto)
  - [`allow_insecure_crypto`](#body-allow-insecure-crypto) — the value is `true` → kept with a notice
- [`openconnect_mtu_invalid`](../warnings.md#openconnect_mtu_invalid)
  - [`mtu`](#body-mtu) — the value does not fit the field → removed
- [`tls_insecure`](../warnings.md#tls_insecure)
  - [`tls.insecure`](#body-tls-insecure) — the value is `true` → kept with a notice
- [`type_invalid`](../warnings.md#type_invalid)
  - [`user_agent`](#body-user-agent) — the value does not fit the field → removed
  - [`inet4_bind_address`](#body-inet4-bind-address) — the value does not fit the field → removed

## Replacements

**Values.** What the sanitizer does to a value before it reaches the node body.

- `tcp_keep_alive` — normalized: `duration_bare_seconds`
- `tcp_keep_alive_interval` — normalized: `duration_bare_seconds`

## Degradation

**The node is dropped**

- `flavor` — invalid value
- `server` — required and missing
- `token.mode` — required and missing
- `token.secret` — required and missing

**The field is removed, the node lives on**

- `inet4_bind_address` — invalid value
- `mtu` — invalid value
- `tls.certificate_authority_path` — conflicts with another field of the same node
- `tls.client_certificate_path` — conflicts with another field of the same node
- `tls.client_key_path` — conflicts with another field of the same node
- `tls.peer_fingerprint` — invalid value
- `token.secret_path` — conflicts with another field of the same node
- `user_agent` — invalid value

**Kept as is, with a notice**

- `allow_insecure_crypto` — accepted, but worth knowing about
- `tls.insecure` — accepted, but worth knowing about
